limitations_and_boundaries: Chromatin accessibility poorly captured microglia transcriptional state diversity.
The study uses iPSC-derived microglia as a model system, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo microglial states.
Functional validation is limited to a subset of TFs and may not generalize to all identified regulators.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
